title: Index formula for the parity tree
statement: For natural numbers $r,t$ and indices $j<r$ and $k<r^t$, the index corresponding to $(j,k)$ under the canonical bijection from pairs of such indices to indices below $r^{t+1}$ is $j r^t+k$.
